description: Use this when the user wants to publish, draft or schedule a BLOG POST on their Wix site. Publishing costs no credits. A title is REQUIRED (up to 200 characters) and the text becomes the body: plain text or light markdown is turned into Wix's own rich content, and HTML is converted by Wix (up to 30,000 characters). status: publish (default), draft, or scheduled with a future `date`, which Wix schedules natively. The FIRST image becomes the cover; other images and a video are brought into the site's Media Manager and placed in the body. tags and categories take names; one the blog lacks is CREATED, and the reply says which categories. A title over 200 characters, an excerpt over 500, a slug over 100 or more than 30 tags is refused, never cut. The reply is Wix's own copy of the post, with its public address once it is live. Not connected: the user connects it under Connectors > Wix, or you call connect_connector with provider wix (apiKey, siteId).

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

date.description: ISO time to publish at; a future date schedules it on Wix itself

hook.description: the post's angle — a list_hooks id or your own wording, reused exactly

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

imageUrl.description: one image: becomes the cover (featured) image

imageUrls.description: several images: the first is the cover, the rest go inside the body

memberId.description: the site member the post belongs to (default: the author of the site’s latest post)

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

slug.description: the end of the post URL, up to 100 characters

text.description: the body: plain text, light markdown or HTML

title.description: REQUIRED: the post title, up to 200 characters

videoUrl.description: one video, placed in the body

name: post_to_wix
title: Publish a Wix blog post
